title: Simethicone
overview: Simethicone is used to treat the symptoms of gas such as uncomfortable or painful pressure, fullness, and bloating.

sections.Before taking simethicone,: tell your doctor and pharmacist if you are allergic to simethicone or any other drugs.tell your doctor and pharmacist what prescription and nonprescription medications, vitamins, nutritional supplements, and herbal products you are taking or plan to take.tell your doctor if you are pregnant, plan to become pregnant, or are breast-feeding. If you become pregnant while taking simethicone, call your doctor.
